object.name: potted calathea with pink-blotched leaves
object.description: Small calathea plant in a glossy metallic purple plastic tapered pot with a stepped rim. Rounded leaves with bright magenta-pink centers and dark green margins, one solid dark burgundy leaf, burgundy undersides, dark soil visible at the top of the pot.

evidence.location_in_image: left half of the board, center-left of the frame
